'''Racket''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="Adventures" /> [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="Clone Databank" /> [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]]<ref name="Adventures" /> created on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino]] from the [[Clone template/Legends|genetic template]] of [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]].<ref name="Clone Databank" /> As a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]], he<ref name="Adventures" /> stood at 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall and had [[Color/Legends|tan]] skin,<ref name="Clone Databank" /> but unlike most [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], Racket was trained through the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Commando/Legends|commandos]] program to be part of the [[Special Operations Brigade/Legends|Special Operations Brigade]].<ref name="Guide" /> He wore [[Color/Legends|green]]-marked [[Katarn-class commando armor/Legends|''Katarn''-class commando armor]] with a [[Helmet/Legends|helmet]] that had a yellow-green visor. Racket served as the [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] of his [[Squad/Legends|squad]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]],<ref name="Adventures" /> a conflict that spanned from [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> During this [[Time/Legends|time]], Racket led his squad on multiple covert operations.<ref name="Adventures" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|This armor was there to help Commando Sergeant Racket lead his squad through many covert operations|In-game description for Racket's armor|<ref name="Adventures" />}}
Racket's [[Clone trooper armor/Legends|armor]] appeared in the [[2010]] massively multiplayer [[Star Wars video games|online game]] [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']] as a cosmetic option for players, with the in-game store description for the [[Armor/Legends|armor]] mentioning Racket and providing information on the commando.<ref name="Adventures" />
